statements.text: Systems that compute process information by implementing algorithms. For a system to implement an algorithm is for it to have, at some level of abstraction, a range of possible information-carrying states and dispositions to make transitions between them. The algorithm is the abstract specification of those transitions, with inputs and outputs, as a pocket calculator goes from key presses through internal states to a result.

sources.quote: The algorithm implemented by a system is an abstract specification of the transitions between states, including inputs and outputs, which it is disposed to make.
